A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Steamed Fruits are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Fruit]] with any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made in two different ways. The first way requires [[Link]] to Cook [[Hyrule Herb]]s with either [[Apple]]s, [[Palm Fruit]]s, or [[Wildberry|Wildberries]], as none of these [[Ingredient]]s provide an [[Added Effect]]. Link can also use two Ingredients with differing Effects, as these will cancel each other out. Eating these [[Meal]]s will heal some of his [[Heart]]s. They are regional dishes, made by steaming near-ripe Fruits in the leaves of plants. Both the kind of Fruit and the type of herb, Vegetable, or Flower used will effect the type of Steamed Fruit made: * '''Hearty Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Steamed Fruit}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Durian]]s, [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. By eating them, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will be granted [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Enduring Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Steamed Fruit}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s or other enduring Ingredients. They can be eaten to completely restore and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Steamed Fruit}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]], [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. When eaten, Link's movement speed will be boosted. * '''Spicy Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Steamed Fruit}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Spicy Pepper]]s, [[Warm Safflina]]s, or other spicy Ingredients. Link can eat them to gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Steamed Fruit}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfruit]]s, [[Electric Safflina]]s, or other electric Ingredients. If they're eaten, they'll grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Steamed Fruit}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Thistle]]s, [[Mighty Bananas]], or other might Ingredients. Eating them will provide Link with a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Steamed Fruit}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, [[Armoranth]]s, or other tough Ingredients. Link will receive a boost to his [[Defense]] when he eats these fruits. * '''Sneaky Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Steamed Fruit}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. They will grant Link a boost to his [[Stealth]] when he eats them. * '''Chilly Steamed Fruit''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Steamed Fruit}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A regional dish made by steaming near-ripened fruits in the leaves of fragrant plants.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hydromelon]]s, [[Cool Safflina]]s, or other chilly Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Steamed Fruits have the same [[Recipe]] that they did in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] a [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with a piece of [[Fruit]]. However, [[Hylian Tomato]]es are unable to be used when making this [[Meal]], as the result will instead by [[Steamed Tomatoes]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Simmered Fruit }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
